query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT id,notice_type,notice_type_new,title,pub_time,url,web_name,(content IS NOT NULL) AS content_present,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY notice_type_new ORDER BY pub_time DESC,id DESC,url DESC) AS rn FROM public.news_notice WHERE pub_time >= %s AND pub_time < %s) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn<=4 ORDER BY notice_type_new NULLS LAST,rn
limitations: Up to four most recent titles per source new type; not an authoritative type dictionary or random sample. Public-disclosure metadata only.
